newsitem.title: USA: Clinton vows to veto private school vouchers.
newsitem.headline: Clinton vows to veto private school vouchers.

text.p: President Clinton would veto tax cut legislation if it included a special tax break aimed at parents of children enrolled in private elementary and high schools, the White House said on Wednesday.
Spokesman Mike McCurry said Clinton leveled the veto threat at a proposal sponsored by Sen. Paul Coverdell, a Georgia Republican, in a letter to congressional leaders.

The leaders said on Wednesday Coverdell's plan was dead. It would have allowed parents to contribute $2,000 a year after-tax to an education account. The interest earned would be tax-free if used for the child's education.
